selection: Latest completed A2 training run with the full 20-case MuJoCo evaluation. The later model_200.pt in resume_validation is a one-update checkpoint-resume test and is not included.
limitations: 200-update pilot with one training seed; convergence is not established.
Several symmetry and stair-tracking metrics improved, but flat lateral drift, front calf phase bias, and 0.5 m/s settled completion regressed relative to the 219k baseline.
Evaluation seeds vary actuator delays, not the full training domain randomization.
The baseline deployment default is retained; this candidate is selected explicitly with --policy.
config_note: params/env.yaml captures the original training settings with machine-specific asset, log, cache and dataset paths replaced by repository-relative paths. Registered task configuration resolves paths for new runs.

packaging.checkpoint_change: Only initial_checkpoint.path was made repository-relative; every model tensor, optimizer state, curriculum state, and counter was verified unchanged.
packaging.environment_snapshot_change: Machine-specific filesystem paths were made repository-relative.
